description: Marketing messages sent to customers (Email, SMS, WhatsApp, Push, Voice), one row per send, with delivery, open, click and conversion outcomes, on event time. Typed, normalized and checked from workspace.bronze.campaign_sends.

load.notes: One file per business day (process_date; 1,083 files). customers and marketing_campaigns are joined from Bronze (broadcast) for the timeline and consent flags.

send_id.description: Send identifier (SND- + 20 characters), trimmed and upper-cased. Primary key.

event_ts.description: Send time (Bronze send_date). Use it for every time-based filter and split.

process_date.description: Business date with a 06:00 cut-off (436,429 rows, 25.0%, carry the previous day) and the landing partition of the row. Partition/business key only.

subject.description: Email subject line (Spanish); NULL for other channels and for about 10% of emails.

send_status.description: Delivery status; Sent exactly when was_delivered.

was_delivered.description: Whether the message reached the recipient.

was_opened.description: Whether the message was opened. NULL when not delivered or when the channel does not track opens (WhatsApp, Voice).

open_ts.description: First open time; present exactly when was_opened.

was_clicked.description: Whether a link was clicked. False (not NULL) on untracked sends: rates must use engagement_tracked as denominator.

click_ts.description: First click time; present exactly when was_clicked.

click_count.description: Number of clicks (1-5 in the data); present exactly when was_clicked.

had_conversion.description: Whether the send led to a conversion (always after a click). False on untracked sends.

conversion_ts.description: Conversion time; present exactly when had_conversion.

conversion_value.description: Conversion value (100-5,000, currency not stated); present exactly when had_conversion.

open_device.description: Device of the first open; about 10% missing among opened sends.

open_country.description: Country of the first open as delivered; always the customer's home country.

open_country_code.description: FIX: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of open_country after accent folding.

failure_reason.description: Why an undelivered send failed (any channel); about 5% missing among undelivered sends.

send_cost.description: Cost of the send (0.0001-0.30, currency not stated); about 15% missing.

engagement_tracked.description: True for delivered Email, Push and SMS sends, the only ones with open tracking; the denominator for open, click and conversion rates (WhatsApp and Voice record no opens and no clicks).

sent_outside_campaign_window.description: FLAG: event_date falls outside the campaign's start_date..end_date (8,277 sends after the end). NULL when the campaign is unknown.

sent_before_registration.description: FLAG: event_date is before the customer's registration date (322,739 sends). NULL when the customer is unknown.

customer_opted_out.description: FLAG: the customer's accepts_marketing is False (874,417 sends, 50.1%). Consent is a current snapshot without a timestamp, so this cannot show the send preceded the opt-out; do not treat it as a violation. NULL when the customer is unknown.

checks.name: send_id_format
checks.description: Identifier follows the SND- + 20 characters pattern.

checks.name: process_date_business_cutoff
checks.expr: process_date = event_date OR (process_date = date_sub(event_date, 1) AND date_format(event_ts, 'HH:mm') <= '06:00')
checks.description: process_date is the send date, or the previous day for sends before the 06:00 cut-off (28 rows at 06:00:xx sit on the boundary); never a later day.

checks.name: delivered_matches_status
checks.description: was_delivered is true exactly for Sent.

checks.name: opens_only_when_tracked
checks.description: was_opened is known exactly for delivered Email, Push and SMS sends.

checks.name: no_engagement_when_untracked
checks.description: Untracked sends (undelivered, WhatsApp, Voice) show no clicks or conversions.

checks.name: funnel_order
checks.expr: (NOT was_clicked OR coalesce(was_opened, false)) AND (NOT had_conversion OR was_clicked)
checks.description: A click needs an open and a conversion needs a click.

checks.name: funnel_timestamps_present
checks.expr: (open_ts IS NOT NULL) = coalesce(was_opened, false) AND (click_ts IS NOT NULL) = was_clicked AND (click_count IS NOT NULL) = was_clicked AND (conversion_ts IS NOT NULL) = had_conversion AND (conversion_value IS NOT NULL) = had_conversion
checks.description: Each funnel timestamp (and click_count, conversion_value) is present exactly when its flag is true.

checks.name: funnel_timestamps_ordered
checks.expr: coalesce(open_ts >= event_ts, true) AND coalesce(click_ts >= open_ts, true) AND coalesce(conversion_ts >= click_ts, true)

checks.name: failure_reason_only_when_undelivered
checks.expr: failure_reason IS NULL OR NOT was_delivered
checks.description: Delivered sends carry no failure reason.

checks.name: subject_only_on_email
checks.description: Only emails have a subject line.

checks.name: template_matches_campaign
checks.expr: template_used IS NULL OR template_used RLIKE concat('^template_', campaign_id, '_[0-9]+$')
checks.description: The template belongs to the send's campaign.

checks.name: event_not_in_future
checks.description: The send did not happen in the future.
